system.description:
This drone is a micro-missile housed in a frame that suspends it in the air and acts as a launch platform. The entire mechanism is small enough that it can be deployed as a .50 round, or six of them can be launched at a time via grenade launcher, though at half the range of standard ammunition for both, as the projectile must deploy at a speed it can halt to loiter until needed. Nanodot light and vibration sensors project sound and images to a paired device or implant, though quality is poor, imposing a -2 penalty to tests to analyze such output. Any number of deployed, hovering rounds can be fired once per round without using an action, inflicting 1d6 ballistic wound damage on a successful attack roll. The lazy round’s internal guidance system makes the attack roll with a +4 bonus and a Range increment of 10 yards. Alternately, the operator can use a major action to fire one but gets to make an Accuracy (Drone Weaponry) test with the lazy round’s Aid bonus, if any.

Speed/Velocity: 15. Armor Rating: 0. Health: 1. Automation: Standard.
